property_summary: After calling NETM(), the deployer (owner) balance equals totalDistributed (reference) for every input; the mutant sets it to totalSupply so there exist inputs where balances[owner] != totalDistributed and the property breaks.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to balances[owner] so NETM sets the deployer balance to totalSupply instead of totalDistributed, which changes balances observed after NETM.
